ov: About 410 species of intelligent, mostly tropical birds with strong curved beaks and grasping feet. They include macaws, cockatoos and budgies, and a third of all species are threatened with extinction.
len: 8 cm (buff-faced pygmy parrot) to 1 m (hyacinth macaw)
rg: Mostly tropical and subtropical regions, with the greatest variety in South America and Australasia.
df: Mostly seeds, nuts, fruit, buds and other plant material; a few species sometimes eat animals.
fx: Large parrots such as macaws and cockatoos can live 80 years, with records of over 100.
